rows.definition: ErrNativeStructuredUnsupported is the typed per-request refusal returned when a native structured-output request cannot be honored without violating its JSON-schema or execution-mode contract.
rows.distinction: It classifies one refused native structured-output request; it does not claim that structured output lacks all support, measure coverage, or assign a product maturity rung.

rows.definition: V41SparsePrefillBackend predicate admitting the ordinary whole-panel V4.1 sparse-prefill route only when the backend physical-acceptance contract is available; the CUDA implementation currently returns false independently of successful compilation or explicit private physical-witness execution.
rows.distinction: This per-backend ordinary-route admission decision is not generic implemented-path support, a numerical correctness verdict, or a maturity grade; a compiled candidate and private fixture execution cannot turn it on implicitly.
